feeds.title: OpenAI Alignment - Research and Releases
feeds.description: Research posts and releases from the OpenAI Alignment Research Blog, including the ones hosted on openai.com that the official feed leaves out.
feeds.upstream_status: Official /rss.xml exists but was last built 2026-07-21 and omits every externally hosted post.

feeds.title: OpenAI Alignment - Misalignment Notices
feeds.description: Dated notices about live misalignment investigations, from the OpenAI Misalignment Notices and Reports page.
feeds.upstream_status: No feed of any kind upstream.

feeds.title: OpenAI Alignment - Misalignment Reports
feeds.description: Individual reports documenting misaligned model behaviour observed in training and deployment.
feeds.upstream_status: No feed of any kind upstream.
feeds.notes: Upstream shows only a last-updated date, so each entry keeps the date this generator first saw it and does not jump back to the top when edited.

feeds.title: OpenAI Alignment - everything
feeds.description: Research and releases, misalignment notices and misalignment reports from the OpenAI Alignment Research Blog, merged into one feed. Each entry is tagged with its section.

feeds.title: OpenAI Alignment - everything (latest 50)
feeds.description: As openai-alignment-all, capped at the 50 most recent entries.

feeds.title: OpenAI System Cards
feeds.description: System cards and deployment safety updates from the OpenAI Deployment Safety Hub.
feeds.upstream_status: A /posts.xml exists but is a broken dev build: zero items and a localhost link.

feeds.title: METR - English only
feeds.description: METR's blog, notes and evaluation reports with translated duplicates removed. Full article text preserved.
feeds.upstream_status: Official feed.xml is valid but ~8.9 MB and interleaves /es/ and /zh-Hans/ duplicates of English posts.

feeds.title: METR - English only (latest 50)
feeds.description: As metr-en, capped at the 50 most recent entries. Use this one if your reader struggles with the full feed's size.
feeds.upstream_status: Official feed.xml is ~8.9 MB with translated duplicates.

feeds.title: METR - English only (headlines and summaries)
feeds.description: As metr-en, but with the full article bodies stripped out - title, summary and link only. Around 50 KB instead of 5 MB, for readers that choke on large feeds.
feeds.upstream_status: Official feed.xml is ~8.9 MB with translated duplicates.
feeds.notes: Click through to read; article text is not carried in this variant.

feeds.title: Dario Amodei
feeds.description: Essays and short posts from Dario Amodei's personal site, with the full text of each piece. Entries are tagged Essay or Short post, matching the site's own split.
feeds.upstream_status: No feed of any kind upstream, and no structured dates in the markup.
feeds.notes: The site prints a month and year rather than a full date, so every entry is dated the first of its month.

feeds.title: TLDR AI
feeds.description: The TLDR AI daily newsletter, one entry per issue with every story's headline, read time and summary, grouped under the issue's own sections. Sponsor slots and utm tracking are removed.
feeds.upstream_status: Official /api/rss/ai exists but each item is only the emoji headline and a link: no summary and none of the stories.

feeds.title: Tangle - the good parts
feeds.description: Tangle's daily edition cut down to Today's topic (the story, what the left and right are saying, and Isaac Saul's take) and Under the radar, plus Isaac's standalone essays. Sponsors, quick hits, extras, teasers, paywalled previews and the Sunday recap are left out.
feeds.upstream_status: Official /rss/ is complete but interleaves the daily with video and podcast teasers, paywalled previews, recaps, reader essays and sponsor cards.

feeds.title: Scholar Inbox - daily paper digest
feeds.description: Scholar Inbox's daily digest of recommended papers, one entry per day, each paper with its title, authors, venue and relevance score, the title linking to a public arXiv or Google Scholar search.
feeds.upstream_status: Email only. Each digest is a stack of styled table cards, titled with an ambiguous dd/mm date, and every link in it is a personal auto-login link.
feeds.notes: Rebuilt from each paper's fields; nothing from the email's markup or links is kept.

feeds.title: The Conversation - newsletters
feeds.description: The Conversation's Global daily, AI weekly and business weekly newsletters, flattened to the editor's note and each story's section, image, headline, byline and standfirst, with every headline linked straight to its article. Entries are tagged with which newsletter they came from.
feeds.upstream_status: Email only. Nested layout tables, logos, a tracking pixel and footers, and every link wrapped in a per-recipient click tracker.
feeds.notes: A headline that cannot be matched to its article by exact title is left unlinked rather than pointed at the tracker.

feeds.title: AI Digest
feeds.description: AI Digest's email updates. Held empty for now: issues are published only once a real one has been reviewed and its links and images can be allowlisted.
feeds.upstream_status: Email only; no feed of any kind upstream.
feeds.notes: Empty until an issue has been reviewed and its formatter enabled.

feeds.title: Project Syndicate
feeds.description: Project Syndicate commentary, each entry with its lead image and photo credit, the summary, the full byline and a clean link to the article. The articles themselves are paywalled and are not reproduced.
feeds.upstream_status: Official /rss is valid but summary-only, keeps the image in an enclosure most readers ignore, tags every link with utm tracking and credits only the first author of co-written pieces.

feeds.title: Gates Notes
feeds.description: Bill Gates's essays from Gates Notes with the full text of each, including pull quotes, images and photo essays, tagged with the site's own topics.
feeds.upstream_status: The old /home/rss feed is gone, and every gatesnotes.com page answers scripts with a 403. Read from the content API the site itself is built from.
